proposal.description: The at-target test is suppressed while the ceiling is still at the MIN_ON_CNT floor, as if to stop the ramp finishing on S_SS entry. Because of that, a max_on_limit equal to the floor is not finished on the first clock, which the header requires.
proposal.reason: With max_on_limit programmed equal to MIN_ON_COUNTS, SS_done no longer rises on the first S_SS clock. Instead max_on_counts steps to floor+1, above the limit, at the end of the first step window. It is clamped back and SS_done is set only on the clock after that, a whole step period late.

proposal.description: The idle re-arm loads the step-window counter with 1, counting cycles from one, instead of 0. The first step window of every soft start is therefore one switching cycle short.
proposal.reason: On each new S_SS entry (after S_OFF or hiccup), the first ceiling step lands one PWM falling edge early when cycles_per_step >= 2. With cycles_per_step = 1 the counter starts past the terminal count, so the first step is held for nearly the full counter range. Either way max_on_counts and SS_done change at different times.

proposal.description: A ceiling found above a lowered max_on_limit is walked down one count per clock, as a gentle ramp-down, instead of being clamped to the limit at once. SS_done is still raised at once.
proposal.reason: If max_on_limit is lowered below the ceiling during S_SS, SS_done rises straight away and the supervisor moves to S_RUN on the next clock. The ceiling then stops partway down, so max_on_counts stays above max_on_limit for all of S_RUN instead of equalling it.
